newsitem.title: INDIA: India ACC raising power capacity to 150 MW.
newsitem.headline: India ACC raising power capacity to 150 MW.

text.p: Indian cement giant, Associated Cement Companies Ltd (ACC) will raise its power generation capacity to 150 megawatts (MW) during 1997/98 (April-March), a top official said.
The electricity generated will take care of 80 percent of ACC's energy needs, executive vice chairman S. Ganguly told reporters on Wednesday night.
It currently had captive capacity of 100 MW, consisting of 75 MW thermal and 25 MW diesel.
Ganguly expects its power generating costs to be lower than what state-run electricity boards charge big industrial customers.
